description: This Java source file defines the UomWorker class, which provides utility methods for unit of measurement conversions, including time unit conversions and value conversions using a service dispatcher in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UomWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for unit of measurement handling, including time unit conversions and value conversions via services.

methods.name: uomTimeToCalTime
methods.description: Converts a unit of measure ID to a corresponding Calendar field and multiplier for time calculations.

methods.name: addUomTime
methods.description: Adds a specified UOM time value to a Calendar object, optionally starting from a given Timestamp.

methods.name: convertUom
methods.description: Converts a numerical value from one unit of measure to another by calling the 'convertUom' service in the OFBiz framework.
